objects.name: Cauldron
objects.visual_description: A large, black iron cauldron with intricate engravings, used for brewing potions.

objects.name: Potion Shelf
objects.visual_description: A wooden shelf with a rustic finish, displaying various potion bottles and magical ingredients.

objects.name: Ingredient Cabinet
objects.visual_description: An ornate cabinet with glass doors, containing jars of mystical ingredients for potion-making.

objects.name: Recipe Book
objects.visual_description: An ancient, leather-bound recipe book with glowing pages, filled with potion recipes and spells.

objects.name: Love Potion
objects.visual_description: A heart-shaped vial filled with a shimmering pink liquid, emanating a soft, warm glow, adorned with delicate floral patterns.

objects.name: Potion that turns you into a frog
objects.visual_description: A small, green potion bottle with a shimmering, translucent liquid that seems to ripple like water. It has a tiny frog charm hanging from the neck, adding a playful touch.

objects.name: Invisibility Potion
objects.visual_description: A small, elegant bottle with a shimmering liquid that seems to fade in and out of visibility, adorned with a silver label inscribed with ancient runes.

objects.name: Small Table
objects.visual_description: A quaint wooden table with a polished surface, adorned with intricate carvings, ideal for showcasing colorful potion bottles.

objects.name: Stone Round Door
objects.visual_description: A large, circular door made of weathered stone, adorned with mystical runes and a glowing emblem at its center, blending seamlessly into the enchanting atmosphere of the lab.

objects.name: Magical Long Wand
objects.visual_description: A slender, elegantly carved wand made from dark wood, adorned with shimmering runes that glow softly. It has a delicate, crystal tip that sparkles with magical energy.

objects.name: Coat Rack for Wizards
objects.visual_description: An elegant coat rack carved from dark wood, adorned with mystical symbols and hooks shaped like crescent moons, perfect for hanging wizard robes.

scene_name: Ancient whimsical, cold colors like blues and purples, wobbly cartoonish style
scene_description: An enchanting potion lab filled with colorful potions, ancient shelves, and whimsical magical artifacts. The atmosphere is mysterious yet inviting, perfect for witches and wizards crafting their spells.
visual_style: Ancient whimsical, cold colors like blues and purples, wobbly cartoonish style
